description: Provider-neutral contextual cost recorded for one assignment transport execution. Unobservable metrics remain explicit nulls.

transport.description: Configured transport method used for execution.

adapter_revision.description: Revision digest of the adapter configuration that produced the observation.

assignment_packet_bytes.description: Exact UTF-8 byte size of the canonical assignment export packet.

rendered_prompt_bytes.description: Exact UTF-8 byte size transmitted as the worker prompt.

effective_input_tokens.description: Effective worker input tokens when exposed by the adapter or host.

cached_input_tokens.description: Cached input tokens when exposed by the adapter or host.

output_tokens.description: Worker output tokens when exposed by the adapter or host.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed transport execution time in milliseconds.

orientation_command_count.description: Worker orientation or reread commands when observable.

retry_count.description: Transport or worker retries when observable.

repair_loop_count.description: Review or repair loops attributable to this route when observable.

unknown_fields.description: Metrics the adapter or host could not observe; these are never interpreted as zero.

observation_authority.description: Authority boundary for numeric transport observations.

raw_transcript_stored.description: Context-cost evidence never requires raw transcript retention.

title: Assignment context cost
